the QCT and TDWP results are in good agreement with each other in the energy range below the barrier height, while the CT and QCT results are in good accord with each other in higher energy range.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the H(2) molecule dissociates on the c( 2 × 2 )-Ti/Al( 100 ) surface by overcoming a barrier, and the H(2)/Ti interaction is important for the dissociation process.
the QCT method can provide a good approximation for the quantum dynamics results in the energy regime of 50-200meV, but not in the higher-energy regime.
